spawn_spec.prompt:
Implement the Agents feature for /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite (frontend only; Rust backend command `cmd_agents_detect(names: Vec<String>) -> [{ name, available }]` already exists and is registered).

## Feature spec (Orca parity)
A. **Agent settings persistence** — new file `ui/src/lib/agentsSettings.ts`:
   - Candidate list constant: ["claude", "codex", "gemini", "opencode", "aider", "cursor-agent", "droid", "crush"].
   - localStorage key `ferryx.agents.v1` storing `{ version: 1, defaultAgentId: string | null, overrides: Record<string, { enabled?: boolean; command?: string; args?: string }> }`.
   - API: loadAgentSettings(), saveAgentSettings(), plus pure helpers: mergeDetections(settings, detections) -> resolved list `{ name, available, enabled, command, args }` (defaults: enabled=available && true, command=name, args=""), getLaunchableAgents(resolved) -> enabled && available.
   - Unit tests in ui/src/lib/agentsSettings.test.ts (mock localStorage like other tests in repo do — check an existing test for the pattern).

B. **Settings panel** — extend `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`:
   - Add an "Agents" section/tab following whatever section navigation pattern the dialog already uses (read it first).
   - Contents matching Orca's layout style: 
     - "Default Agent" row: segmented buttons Auto / None / one button per available agent (checkmark on selected).
     - "Installed" header with detected count badge + Refresh button that re-runs detection via invoke("cmd_agents_detect", { names }).
     - Per agent row: name, mono sub-label of command, "Detected"/"Not detected" badge, Enabled/Disabled toggle (disabled state greyed if not detected), expandable Command + Arguments text inputs (mono font) with values from overrides, saving on change (debounced or onBlur) via saveAgentSettings.
   - Update SettingsDialog tests accordingly.

C. **New-tab menu agents group** — extend `ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.tsx`:
   - New optional prop `agents?: Array<{ name: string; command: string; args: string }>` and `onLaunchAgent?: (agent) => void`.
   - When non-empty, render a divider + group label "AGENTS" (tiny uppercase muted label) and one row per agent (Sparkles lucide icon, label = capitalized name, no shortcut). Click calls onLaunchAgent(agent).
   - TabBar.tsx / TerminalSplitView.tsx: passthrough props following the exact pattern just added for onAddMarkdown/onOpenSettings.

D. **App wiring** in `ui/src/App.tsx`:
   - Load settings + run detection once on mount (invoke via tauri isTauri guard — follow existing patterns like getTerminalPreferences which guard with isTauriRuntime(); in browser mode skip detection).
   - onLaunchAgent handler: const sessionId = await spawnTerminal({ workspaceId: activeProject.workspaceId, worktree: activeWorktree identity or null }) — copy how existing terminal spawn works in this codebase (find ensureTabForWorktree/openTab usage); after spawn completes, await writeTerminal({ sessionId, data: `${command} ${args}`.trim() + "\r" }). Reuse reportRuntimeError for catch.
   - Pass computed launchable agents into TabBar chain.

## Gates (all must pass, run from repo root)
- bun run --cwd ui test
- bun run --cwd ui build
Also verify cargo side untouched: no changes outside ui/.

NO git commit. Follow existing code style exactly (read neighboring code first). Return: summary + exact test counts + build result.

### Intent and Resolution

#### 1. RED Test on TabBar DOM Structure
- **Added regression test**: `renders new tab trigger and popover outside the horizontal overflow tablist container to avoid vertical clipping` in `ui/src/components/TabBar.test.tsx`.
- **Exact RED Failure Output**:
  ```
  FAIL  src/components/TabBar.test.tsx > TabBar > renders new tab trigger and popover outside the horizontal overflow tablist container to avoid vertical clipping
  AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
  - Expected: false
  + Received: true
  ❯ src/components/TabBar.test.tsx:331:44
     expect(tablist.contains(newTabButton)).toBe(false);
  ```

#### 2. GREEN Fix
- In `ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx`, moved the `showAdd` block (containing `IconButton` trigger and `NewTabPopover`) outside of the `<div role="tablist" className="flex min-w-0 items-stretch overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">` container, placing it immediately adjacent within `SortableContext`.
- This resolves the CSS overflow clipping issue where the popover was clipped to tab bar height.

#### 3. Restored Agents + Orca New-Tab Integration
- **`ui/src/lib/agentsSettings.ts` & `agentsSettings.test.ts`**: Pure helpers (`loadAgentSettings`, `saveAgentSettings`, `mergeDetections`, `getLaunchableAgents`, `AGENT_CANDIDATES`, localStorage key `ferryx.agents.v1`).
- **`ui/src/lib/tauri.ts`**: Added `detectAgents(names: string[])` invoking `cmd_agents_detect`.
- **`ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.tsx` & `NewTabPopover.test.tsx`**: Added `agents` and `onLaunchAgent` props, rendering `AGENTS` group, plus items for New Terminal, Browser, Markdown, Mobile Emulator, and Agent settings.
- **`ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx` & `TabBar.test.tsx`**: Passed `agents` and `onLaunchAgent` down to `NewTabPopover`.
- **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`**: Threaded `agents` and `onLaunchAgent` through layout tree to `TabBar`.
- **`ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx` & `SettingsDialog.test.tsx`**: Restored the `Agents` section with default agent selector, detected badge + refresh button, per-agent enable toggles, and expandable command/argument override inputs.
- **`ui/src/App.tsx` & `App.test.tsx`**: Restored detection on mount under Tauri runtime, agent launch handler (`spawnTerminal` + `writeTerminal`), and passed computed launchable agents to `TerminalSplitView`.
